researchEvidence.statement: The Transformer paper proposed a sequence-transduction architecture based on attention rather than recurrence and convolutions, and emphasized greater parallelizability during training; this is an architecture result, not a claim that attention solves every reasoning or deployment problem.
researchEvidence.invalidation: The result depends on task, data, implementation, training setup, and evaluation; later systems add components and trade-offs beyond the original paper.
